subject: CSA control boundary & evidence concord — Aureum intake
messages:
From: security@aureum.com (Aureum Security Team)
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: dpo@aureum.com, chris.walters@aureum.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ crosswalk kickoff — scope clarification and artifacts

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this on. Aureum is kicking off our vendor CSA (CAIQ) review for platforms used in production across EU and US regions. Two quick scope clarifications before we start mapping controls to artifacts:

1) Scope: We need to confirm whether Redwood's Private (VPC/on-prem) offering is in-scope for our characterization. Aureum intends to evaluate both Hosted and Private because some teams anticipate private deployment.
2) Residency/marketplace: We’ll also want any Marketplace/partner integrations called out as separate components.

Can you provide an initial crosswalk (control -> artifact) and call out owners for each artifact? Ideally we get a first pass today so we can triage any gaps. Attachments are fine (zipped samples, manifests).

Requested deliverables:
- CAIQ crosswalk spreadsheet (controls mapped to internal control names and artifacts)
- Runtime telemetry sample (sanitized) for token flow/segregation proof
- Ownership roster for artifact custodian contacts

Thanks — we’ll be looping product security if we see redlines.

— Aureum Security
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: security@aureum.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ crosswalk kickoff — scope clarification and artifacts

Chris / Aureum team —

Appreciate the clear ask. Quick answers up front: Hosted API and Dedicated pools are fully in-scope. Private (VPC/on-prem) is scoped only for controls where evidence differs by deployment (key management, network egress, and admin access). We’ll mark those controls with an explicit residency column. Marketplace integrations will be a separate component column in the spreadsheet.

I’m attaching an initial crosswalk (redwood_csa_crosswalk_v1.xlsx) with three tabs: overview, controls-by-component, and artifact-manifest. Highlights:
- Many CAIQ mappings point to our runtime telemetry and orchestration logs (listed under artifact-manifest).
- Controls that vary by deployment are flagged in column G (deployment_delta).
- Owners: added primary owner email + secondary (where applicable).

Next steps I propose:
1) Aureum reviews the attached crosswalk and returns 1) any controls you want expanded, and 2) a prioritized list for proofs.
2) We’ll stage sanitized telemetry (runtime-telemetry-sample.tar.gz) for the first 10 control proofs by EOD.
3) If you need DocuSign access for attestation, send the envelope ID and we’ll route to legal.

Attachment: redwood_csa_crosswalk_v1.xlsx, runtime-telemetry-sample.tar.gz, ownership-roster-20270421.csv

Jonas Weber
Senior Security Engagement Manager
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@aureum.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ crosswalk kickoff — scope clarification and artifacts

Jonas / Chris —

Thanks for the crosswalk, looks like a good start. A few clarifying items from our side before Aureum requests full artifacts:

- Private deploy KMS evidence: for VPC/private, our recommendation is to provide key policy excerpts and HSM attestations. We can provide a redacted policy PDF but need Aureum to confirm whether a copy of the HSM audit (third-party attestation) is required.
- Telemetry sampling: the runtime sample attached is a 1-hour slice. If you need a longer window (7-day sampling) note it in a reply and we’ll stage a larger export (requires infra ops time).
- Marketplace integrations: please confirm the list of partner IDs you want treated as "third-party components" so we can mark control ownership (internal vs partner).

Action items for Aureum:
- Confirm HSM evidence requirement (yes/no)
- Provide partner IDs for marketplace components (if any)
- Priority list for first 10 controls to prove

If Aureum is OK with the HSM policy excerpt + 1-hour telemetry slice for initial review, we can close the first tranche by EOD.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: security@aureum.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ crosswalk kickoff — scope clarification and artifacts

Hi Chris / Aureum team,

We confirm the following and are moving artifacts into the Aureum intake folder:
- HSM evidence: we will provide a redacted HSM attestation PDF and key policy excerpt (attachment: kms-policy-excerpt-redacted.pdf). Full vendor attestation available under NDA.
- Telemetry: initial 1-hour sanitized sample uploaded. If you request 7-day, we’ll need two business days to prepare.
- Owners: ownership-roster-20270421.csv lists the primary custodians for each artifact; Jonas and I are the escalation points.

Deliverable timeline (estimates):
- Tranche 1 (10 controls): crosswalk + 1-hour telemetry + HSM policy excerpt — today by 19:00 PT
- Tranche 2 (expanded proofs / 7-day telemetry): by 2027-04-23 EOD (if requested)

If that schedule works, please reply with the prioritized control list and any partner IDs you flagged. We’ll treat any requests for redlines as a separate workflow and route them to Legal + Product Security.

Regards,
